baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative construction places the subjects inside two coordinated media, سَمُوم and حَمِيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: A penetrating hot wind and heated water form a compound thermal environment: one attacks through moving air and the other through enveloping or contacting liquid.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating hot-wind image supplies the mobile gaseous half of the enclosing medium.
The heated-water image supplies the liquid half of the thermal exposure.

changed_reading.before: Two adjacent names for severe heat.
changed_reading.after: A two-phase habitat of penetrating hot air and heated liquid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَمُوم can image entry through a narrow opening or poison entering the body, while حَمِيم carries bodily effects of heat.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair can be read physiologically: heat finds apertures, enters like poison, and becomes fever, sweat, or internal liquefaction rather than remaining scenery outside the body.

activation_trace.role: The narrow aperture and bodily pore image supplies routes by which the environment penetrates.
The poison-entering-the-body image turns exposure into invasive toxicity.
The sweat and heat-effect image locates the result on and within the body.
The fever image gives the invasive heat a systemic bodily form.

changed_reading.before: The subjects stand near punishing heat.
changed_reading.after: The subjects are permeated by a toxic thermal condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ح م م includes both the nearness and arrival of an affair and its decree or death, while س م م also has a death branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside its material sense, the pair can compress heat, arrival, and death into one present terminal state: what was impending has become the medium they inhabit.

activation_trace.role: The death image gives the scorching medium a terminal horizon.
The nearness and arrival image converts threatened heat into a condition now present.
The decree-and-death image supplies finality without replacing the material hot-water sense.

changed_reading.after: A materialized arrival of an already determined terminal condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated cohort title makes the atmosphere socially assigned as well as spatial: the group is accompanied and surrounded by the very wind-and-water condition that identifies its lot.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating hot wind remains the focus medium that the cohort inhabits.
Companionship and lasting association make the condition read as attached to a named cohort.
Envelopment from all sides strengthens the locative فِى into comprehensive atmospheric enclosure.

structural_cues: The doubled أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَال immediately precedes the verbless locative phrase in 56:42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cohort naming, companionship, and all-sided enclosure; I infer that the medium functions as the cohort's attached atmosphere, while the live alternative is that 56:41 only labels the occupants.

changed_reading.before: Individuals happen to be located amid heat.
changed_reading.after: A named cohort is comprehensively enclosed by a condition that accompanies and identifies it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next two ayat turn expected relief into another delivery system for injury: shade becomes black combustion matter, and it is explicitly denied both cooling and beneficent quality.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating hot wind establishes the exposure from which shade would normally protect.
The hot-water image establishes the second thermal medium that ordinarily might soothe or cleanse.
Protective shade supplies the expected shelter whose function is then reversed.
Blackness, coal, and smoke turn the offered shade into combustion residue rather than refuge.
The negated cooling branch removes the primary physical function of shade.
The negated generosity and honor branch removes any humane or beneficent remainder from the shelter.

structural_cues: وَظِلٍّ continues the coordinated locative list, and لَا ... وَلَا applies a double functional negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat, shade, black smoke, and explicit denial of coolness and beneficence; I infer a designed reversal of relief, while the alternative is a simple cumulative list of separate torments.

changed_reading.before: Hot wind and hot water are two harsh environmental items.
changed_reading.after: They belong to a closed anti-refuge system in which every apparent avenue of relief reproduces the injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: Former expansive ease and sustained insistence are answered by an equally sustained but invasive medium: the behavioral refusal to release becomes, by analogy, a condition that will not release its occupants.

activation_trace.role: Steadfast persistence lets the hot medium be modeled as a condition that holds to its occupants.
Expansive luxury that lets its possessor loose supplies the former condition now reversed.
Binding and knotting give the repeated insistence a constrictive material analogue.
Determined persistence supplies the temporal behavior transferred to the enduring exposure.
The grave offense supplies the object of persistence and keeps the analogy morally tethered.

structural_cues: قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ contrasts the former condition with the present one, while كَانُوا and يُصِرُّونَ mark durative conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies former unbounded ease, habitual insistence, and branches of binding and persistence; I infer a measure-for-measure transfer from conduct to environment, while the alternative is causal juxtaposition without material analogy.

changed_reading.before: The heat is an externally imposed episode.
changed_reading.after: The heat is a tenacious counter-condition whose refusal to let go mirrors their prior refusal to desist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of post-mortem raising is answered by the convergence of first and last at a fixed appointment, activating the focus branch of ح م م as an affair whose time has drawn near and arrived.

activation_trace.role: The arrival and nearness of an affair makes the hot condition the realized appointment.
Decree and death add terminal determination to the appointment without cancelling the hot-water sense.
Loss of life supplies the boundary the speakers assume cannot be crossed.
The stirring of what was still supplies the denied reversal that brings them to the focus condition.
The first cohort supplies one temporal edge of the comprehensive summons.
The last cohort supplies the opposite temporal edge of the comprehensive summons.
Gathering dispersed parts compresses all cohorts into one destined encounter.
The fixed appointment gives exact temporal structure to the focus branch of imminence.

structural_cues: The skeptical question in 56:47-48 is answered by قُلْ and the emphatic لَمَجْمُوعُونَ in 56:49-50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death, reanimation, total gathering, and a fixed appointment; I infer that the nonthermal ح م م branches resonate with the appointment's realized arrival, while literal hot water remains the primary material referent.

changed_reading.before: The pair names what the occupants physically undergo.
changed_reading.after: The physical condition also embodies the precise arrival they had treated as impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Eating, swallowing, belly-filling, and compulsive drinking create an inward circuit. The hot medium surrounding the subjects is routed through mouth and belly until environment and bodily interior are continuous.

activation_trace.role: Narrow openings and bodily pores supply the ingress pattern later made explicit by eating and drinking.
Poison entering the body supplies the toxic logic of the inward route.
Hot water supplies the same focus substance later consumed as drink.
Melting fat supplies a possible internal effect once the hot liquid enters the body.
Taking food moves the punitive medium from surrounding space toward the body's interior.
Swallowing and gulping sharpen the forced passage through the mouth.
Filling to the capacity of a vessel makes the body a saturated container.
The belly and inner side explicitly locate the circuit inside the body.
Taking liquid carries the focus حَمِيم through the alimentary route.
The repeated hot-water branch identifies the ingested liquid with the focus medium.
Unquenchable thirst closes the circuit by making harmful intake continue rather than relieve it.

structural_cues: The participial sequence لَآكِلُونَ, فَمَالِئُونَ, فَشَارِبُونَ, فَشَارِبُونَ advances from intake to filling to repeated intake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered ingestion sequence, bodily filling, repeated حَمِيم, and unrelieved thirst; I infer continuity between the surrounding medium of 56:42 and the later internal route, while the alternative is a sequence of distinct punishments.

changed_reading.before: The pair describes an atmosphere outside and around the subjects.
changed_reading.after: The atmosphere becomes an ingestive loop that penetrates, fills, heats, and compels renewed intake from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit denial of generosity and the closing designation of the sequence as prepared guest-provision recast the hot water as a served reception whose every hospitality function has been inverted into recompense.

activation_trace.role: Hot water supplies the focus substance that later functions as the reception's drink.
Negated generosity and honor mark the shelter and provision as anti-hospitality.
Prepared provision for an arriving guest supplies the reception frame for the whole sequence.
Reckoning and recompense convert the inverted reception from random cruelty into an answer to prior conduct.

structural_cues: The demonstrative هَذَا in 56:56 gathers the preceding food, drink, and environment under نُزُلُهُمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated generosity, prepared guest-provision, and recompense; I infer a deliberately inverted reception in which حَمِيم is served, while the alternative is that نُزُل means provision without activating a broader hospitality script.

changed_reading.before: Hot water is one item in an inventory of pain.
changed_reading.after: Hot water is the served drink of a counter-hospitality whose shelter, refreshment, and welcome have all reversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fire-feeding branch of eating is distant from the immediate form 'eaters'; it remains valid as a packet-backed activation anchored in the focus's hot wind and black combustion matter, but downstream prose should present the eater-as-fuel reversal only as a possible secondary mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَمُوم supplies penetrating combustion-driving air, and the ح م م inventory supplies black coal and smoke.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating hot-wind image supplies moving heat that can sustain a combustion frame.
Black coal and smoke supply the focus anchor for combustion residue.
Feeding fire and making it flare allows eating to reverse into an act that feeds the punitive system.
Interlocking wood supplies a fuel-like material bridge between the tree and combustion.

changed_reading.before: The subjects consume food while enduring an independently existing heat.
changed_reading.after: Their consumption may also image a feedback loop in which the eaters continually feed the combustion that surrounds them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates private-inside and close-relative branches rather than the direct heat senses; it remains anchored in both focus roots and is reinforced by companionship and guest-provision, but downstream prose should mark 'toxic intimacy' as a relational overlay, not a lexical replacement for scorching wind and hot water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَمُوم activates what enters the private interior, while حَمِيم can name an intimate or close relative.

activation_trace.role: The private quality lodged inside makes the harmful medium invasively intimate.
The close and affectionate relative image supplies the intimacy that the hot medium grotesquely occupies.
Companionship makes the harmful condition read as an inseparable associate.
Guest-provision supplies a social setting in which expected care is replaced by invasive harm.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is hostile because it is physically extreme.
changed_reading.after: The punishment may also be hostile by occupying the positions of companion, intimate, and host-provision while entering the body's private interior.

strongest_changes: The following shade and double negation turn the pair into a closed anti-refuge system rather than a loose list of hot substances.
The eating-to-filling-to-drinking sequence turns external exposure into an inward bodily circuit.
The final نُزُل and دِين frame the hot water as served counter-hospitality and recompense.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support both direct thermal senses and ingress, bodily, temporal, and relational branches; context progressively activates these without requiring the material reading to be abandoned.
remaining_uncertainties: The appointment and persistence readings depend on secondary ح م م branches and should remain layered over the primary hot-water sense.
The combustion feedback is mechanically coherent but depends on a form-distant branch of ء ك ل.
The toxic-intimacy model is strongly anchored at branch level but remains a social overlay rather than a likely standalone rendering.
